'''''Carlina corymbosa''''', common name '''clustered carline thistle''', is a [[herbaceous]] [[perennial]] plant in the genus ''[[Carlina]]'', belonging to the family [[Asteraceae]].

==Description==
[[File:Asteraceae - Carlina corymbosa.JPG|thumb|right|Flower of ''Carlina corymbosa'']]
''Carlina corymbosa'' reaches on average {{convert|10|-|90|cm|0}} in height. This plant has rhizomatous roots, overwintering buds situated just below the soil surface ([[Raunkiær plant life-form#Hemicryptophytes|hemicryptophyte]])<ref>[http://herbarivirtual.uib.es/cas-med/especie/4398.html ''Herbario Virtual'']</ref> and an almost leafless stalk growing directly from the ground ([[Glossary of botanical terms|scapose]]). The stem is green to whitish, thick and erect. The leaves are alternate, sessile or [[wikt:amplexicaul|amplexicaul]] and lobed with spines on the margins.<ref>Pignatti S. - Flora d'Italia – Edagricole – 1982, Vol. III, pag. 214</ref>

The yellow flowers are terminal, {{convert|2.0|-|3.5|cm|1|abbr=on}} in diameter and surrounded by thorny [[bract]]s. The outer bracts are similar to leaves, while the inner bracts surrounding the disk florets are membranous and stiff, with a golden color. The flowering period extends from June through August. The flowers are [[Glossary of botanical terms|hermaphrodite]] and are pollinated by insects (usually bees, wasps and butterflies) ([[entomogamy]]). The fruits are achenes {{convert|2.5|mm|1}} long, each with a feathery yellow pappus. Seed dispersal is by wind ([[anemochory]]).<ref>Julve, Ph., 1998 ff. - The  French Flora Database [http://perso.wanadoo.fr/philippe.julve/catminat.htm Baseflor] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20060207043607/http://perso.wanadoo.fr/philippe.julve/catminat.htm# |date=2006-02-07 }}</ref>

==Distribution==
This plant is native to the [[Mediterranean]] and it is present in [[Albania]], [[Balearic Islands]], [[Bulgaria]], [[Corsica]], [[Crete]], [[France]], [[Greece]], [[Spain]], [[Italy]], former [[Jugoslavia]], [[Sardinia]], [[Sicily]] and [[Turkey]].<ref>Tutin, T. G. & al. (ed.) (1968). Flora Europaea. (vol.2) Cambridge University Press, Cambridge [http://rbg-web2.rbge.org.uk/cgi-bin/nph-readbtree.pl/feout?FAMILY_XREF=&GENUS_XREF=Carlina&SPECIES_XREF=corymbosa&TAXON_NAME_XREF=&RANK= Flora Europaea]</ref>

==Habitat==
It grows in sunny, sandy or rocky lands, in [[grassland]] soils, on roadside, in fallow lands and in dry places, at an altitude of {{convert|0|-|1200|m}} above sea level.
